verdict.rationale: Expensify's own marketing says it can automatically create, submit, approve, and reimburse expenses (expensify-docs-27). Employees capture out-of-pocket receipts with SmartScan (expensify-docs-6), and reports can be submitted automatically on a schedule (expensify-docs-31). However, the reimbursement claim is a single one-line mention with no detail on how payouts are made. Missing for 10: documented direct-deposit/ACH payout method, evidence of reimbursement arriving within days, status tracking from submission through payout, and independent corroboration of the reimbursement flow.
